list: Leonida Trophy Atlas data: the official 55 trophies with original guides

roadmap.title: Landfall: prologue and Chapter 1
roadmap.advice: Play the opening straight through. Gone Fishing teaches driving, shooting and the partner swap, and Chapter 1 opens Vice City up. Try one of each activity type as icons appear, so Master of None is out of the way early.

roadmap.title: Chapters 2 and 3, first stranger strands
roadmap.advice: Push the story through Chapters 2 and 3. As stranger markers appear, start the strands for Andy and Kenton and finish them; their finales are story trophies and the strand count feeds Strangers & Freaks.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4 and the stranger web
roadmap.advice: Finish Chapter 4 and clear the remaining stranger strands (Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus the named missions Headliners and Child's Play. Eight completed strands complete Strangers & Freaks.

roadmap.title: Heists and the final mission
roadmap.advice: Run the big set pieces: The Cartel Heist, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory, then the final mission. While your partner is with you, grab the two partner crime trophies (Hot Together and Retail Therapy) before the credits.

roadmap.title: The Leonida sweep: counts and collectibles
roadmap.advice: Free-roam cleanup. Work the counted grinds (stunts, shooting range golds, drone races, races, challenges), the collectible sets (cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, areas, garages) and every one-off stunt trophy. Sweep meditation spots region by region before story changes lock any out: Positive Mental Attitude is the one missable trophy in the game.

roadmap.title: 100 percent and the platinum
roadmap.advice: When the in-game completion counter reads 100 percent, A Long Road unlocks. The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 are all earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is not a task of its own: PlayStation awards it automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Use this atlas as the checklist, work the roadmap in stage order (story, strands, heists, then the counted sweep), and keep an eye on Positive Mental Attitude, the one missable entry in the list. When A Long Road lands for 100 percent completion, this trophy follows immediately.
steps: Complete every story and stranger-strand trophy in stages 1 to 4
Clear the counted grinds and collectible sets in stage 5
Attain 100 percent completion so A Long Road unlocks
The platinum is awarded automatically once all 54 others are earned

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission and the game's tutorial rolled into one: a boat trip that teaches movement, driving and the partner dynamic before Vice City opens up. It is fully linear and cannot be missed or failed permanently, so just play the prologue through and the trophy pops on the mission complete screen.
steps: Start the campaign and play through the prologue sequence
Follow the on-screen prompts during the fishing trip
Finish the mission to trigger the Chapter 1 title card

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A pure story progression trophy: finish every mission filed under Chapter 1 in the mission log. Nothing in the chapter is missable, and side activities can wait, so the fastest route is to follow the story markers back to back until the chapter closes.
steps: Follow the story markers through each Chapter 1 mission
Keep both partners alive through the chapter finale
The trophy pops when the Chapter 2 title card appears

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the campaign. The chapter leans into the drug-trade storyline and introduces the business properties that later feed the money trophies, so take the introductions it offers rather than hoarding every dollar. As with every chapter trophy, it unlocks automatically at the chapter's end.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 missions in log order
Take the business introductions the chapter offers
Complete the chapter finale to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3, the chapter that opens Vice City proper and its nightlife economy. Story markers alone will carry you through; the chapter also unlocks several activity types, so a quick lap of the new icons here pays off Master of None later.
steps: Follow the story through the Chapter 3 mission chain
Try each newly unlocked activity type once as it appears
Finish the chapter finale to pop the trophy

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame sequence. By now the stranger strands should be well under way; if any strand finales are still open, clear them before starting the final run of story missions in stage 4.
steps: Complete the Chapter 4 missions in order
Wrap up open stranger strands between story missions
Finish the chapter finale to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: finish the campaign's final mission. Before you start it, spend a session on the two partner trophies (Hot Together and Retail Therapy) while the story still pairs you up naturally, and make sure your meditation-spot sweep is current, since the ending changes parts of the map. The trophy pops at the credits.
steps: Earn Hot Together and Retail Therapy before the finale if still open
Stock ammo, armor and a fast getaway car for both partners
Complete the final mission and watch the credits roll

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission in the early campaign, an errand that turns into a chase. It sits on the critical path, so it cannot be skipped or missed; finish it and the trophy is yours.
steps: Pick up the Breakfast Run mission from the story marker
Complete the delivery and the chase that follows
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the campaign's headline robbery mission: a planned job with setup beats, a loud entry and a long escape. It is a main story mission and cannot be missed. Go in with full armor and your best rifle; the escape is the hard part, so save your partner's special ability for the roadblocks.
steps: Complete the heist setup missions as they appear
Enter with full armor and a stocked rifle
Lose the heat after the vault run to finish the mission

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission in the middle chapters, a quieter character mission built around the family storyline. It is on the critical path and unlocks as the story advances; play it when its marker appears and the trophy follows at the mission end.
steps: Start Child's Play from the story marker when it appears
Follow the mission's objectives to the final scene
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission built around a Leonida media event that goes sideways. It is part of the main campaign chain, so it cannot be missed; bring a scoped rifle for the rooftop sequence and the rest plays out as a standard story mission.
steps: Start Headliners from the story marker
Hold the rooftop position during the event sequence
Escape the area to finish the mission

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the airport set piece: a story mission that storms Vice City International Airport. It is mandatory campaign content. Stock up before the marker, because the mission locks you into the airport grounds for a long firefight and a runway chase.
steps: Start VCIA Takedown fully stocked and armored
Push through the terminal firefight with both partners
Complete the runway chase to finish the mission

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a late-campaign assault mission and one of the longest single missions in the story. It is unmissable main-path content. Treat it like a mini-heist: full ammo, armor and snacks before you start, and expect several checkpoints of heavy resistance.
steps: Begin the operation with full ammo, armor and snacks
Work through the assault checkpoints with both partners
Finish the extraction to complete the mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold completion trophy: raise the in-game completion counter to 100 percent. The counter covers the story, all stranger strands, the activity golds and wins, the collectible sets and the property list, which is why this atlas orders the roadmap the way it does. Check the stats page regularly and hunt whatever percentage is missing there first; most players find their last points in an unfinished strand or a half-done collectible set.
steps: Finish the story, all stranger strands and every named mission
Complete the activity requirements: range golds, races, stunts, challenges
Finish every collectible set and buy all garage properties
Watch the stats page reach 100 percent to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunt events across Leonida: jumps, near misses, wheelies, stoppies and airborne tricks all feed the same counter the game tracks. The efficient route is a fast bike on the coastal highways, chaining wheelies and near misses in traffic, then finishing with the marked stunt jumps. The counter in this tracker mirrors the one in the game's stats page, so log your sessions as you go.
steps: Take a fast motorcycle onto the coastal highways
Chain wheelies, stoppies and near-miss passes in traffic
Hit the marked stunt jumps for the remaining count
Check the stats page until the stunt counter reads 250

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once: races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, bowling, stunts, challenges and meditation are the tracked set. You only need to start each one, not win it, so do a lap of the map icons early and this trophy is done in an afternoon.
steps: Open the map and note each activity icon type
Start one event of every type at least once
The trophy pops when the ninth type registers

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across Leonida's ranges. Each challenge fixes the weapon and the target pattern, and gold is a score line, not a clear: learn the pattern, then chase the line. Accuracy bonuses beat raw speed on the pistol and rifle lanes, while the shotgun and SMG lanes reward aggression. Retry is instant, so treat each lane as a short puzzle.
steps: Visit every shooting range and unlock its challenge list
Learn each lane's target pattern on a scoring run
Replay lanes until every one shows a gold medal
The trophy pops when the 42nd gold is banked

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. The drones are provided, so it is pure piloting: learn each course's gate order on a first run, then push for the win on the second. Coastal courses punish wide turns in the wind; the city courses reward cutting corners close to the buildings.
steps: Find the Top Fun start points on the map, one per district
Scout each course once to learn the gate order
Win the race at all 14 locations

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: street, off-road, boat and air events all count, but repeats of the same event do not. Bring a tuned car in its class, or take the provided vehicle and drive clean; the AI forgives one crash, not two. Working through the map's race icons district by district keeps the wins varied and quick.
steps: Pick a race icon and enter with a tuned vehicle for its class
Win it, then move to a different event rather than replaying
Repeat until 20 distinct race wins are logged

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the game's fishing rival, in one of his head-to-head fishing challenges at the piers and lakes. The challenge scores total catch weight in a time limit, so cast toward the deeper water where the heavy fish sit, and upgrade your rod at the bait shop first if you have the cash; the better rod noticeably shortens each fight.
steps: Buy the best rod the bait shop offers
Accept Cal's fishing challenge at a pier or lake
Out-catch him on total weight before the timer ends

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one full game on any arcade cabinet in Leonida's arcades and bars. Completing means reaching the game's own end or final score screen, not just playing a credit, so pick the shortest cabinet (the racing and maze cabinets finish fastest) and play it through.
steps: Enter an arcade or bar with playable cabinets
Choose a short cabinet game and start a credit
Play through to its end screen to pop the trophy

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand: work every Andy mission as his marker appears until the strand's final mission plays out. Stranger strands unlock in stages as the story advances, so if his marker vanishes, progress the campaign and check back. Completing the strand also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Andy's strand at his first stranger marker
Return for each follow-up mission as the story advances
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, the boat-and-marina storyline, through to his final mission. The strand's later missions sit on the water, so a fast boat of your own makes the trips painless. The finale counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Kenton's strand at the marina stranger marker
Work his follow-up missions as they unlock
Complete his final mission on the water

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand: the biker storyline that runs out of the Leonida Keys roadhouses. Bring a motorcycle you like, because several of his missions are rides and chases. His finale is one of the eight strand endings counted by Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Billy's strand at his roadhouse marker
Complete his ride-along missions as they appear
Finish his final mission to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. A strand is the whole chain for one stranger, first marker to finale, and the five named strands in this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more from the map make the eight. Strands gate behind story progress, so sweep the map for question-mark markers after each chapter.
steps: Start every stranger strand you find on the map
Finish the named strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone
Complete any three further strands to reach eight

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand, the smuggling-and-supply storyline. His missions involve moving product under time pressure, so keep a fast, durable truck in a garage before the later runs. The finale adds one more strand to the Strangers & Freaks count.
steps: Start Randy's strand at his stranger marker
Complete his delivery missions as they unlock
Finish his final mission to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand, the street-racing and car-scene storyline. His missions double as race practice, and wins in his events are street races that can also feed Earn Cash, Not Kudos if they are distinct events. Complete his finale for the trophy and another strand toward Strangers & Freaks.
steps: Start Tyrone's strand at his car-meet marker
Win through his race missions as they unlock
Complete his final mission to unlock the trophy

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableReason: Several meditation spots sit at story locations (rooftops, yards and interiors) that the campaign permanently alters as chapters close, and the game offers no chapter select. Sweep each region's spots before finishing that region's chapter, or a spot can end up behind a changed location with no way back on that save file.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida: marked mats and quiet overlooks where a short breathing exercise plays. This is the game's one missable trophy, for the reason flagged in this entry, so do not leave the sweep to the end: clear each region's spots while its chapter is current, using this tracker's counter to log them region by region.
steps: Find a meditation spot and complete the breathing exercise
Sweep each region's spots before closing that region's chapter
Log every spot in this tracker until the count reads 18
The trophy pops at the final spot's exercise

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret, the hunting contact, eventually asks for a unique animal: a one-of-a-kind specimen that stalks a specific habitat in the Leonida wetlands. Work Bret's hunting errands until the unique hunt unlocks, then track it at dawn or dusk when it leaves cover, and bring it down cleanly with a scoped rifle.
steps: Take Bret's hunting errands as they appear
Unlock the unique animal hunt in his chain
Track and take the unique animal in the wetlands

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards hide in shops, bars, lifeguard towers and lookout points all over Leonida, and each set is themed, so the deck screen in your phone shows exactly which cards a set still needs. Focus one set at a time and sweep its district; the third completed set pops the trophy.
steps: Pick a card set on the phone's deck screen
Sweep that set's district for its missing cards
Finish two more sets the same way

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It photo spot interaction at 100 marked locations: viewpoints, murals and landmarks where the game prompts a photo. The spots are dense in Vice City and thinner out in the Keys and the wetlands, so tie the sweep to your area exploration for The Goodtime State and log the count here as you travel.
steps: Stop at each WAiNK It marker you pass and take the photo
Sweep Vice City first, where spots are densest
Work the Keys and wetlands until the count reads 100

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's bite-size Challenges: the timed errands, trick feats and skill checks that post to the challenges board. They refresh and vary by district, and most take under two minutes, so the fastest route is to clear every challenge icon in one district before moving to the next.
steps: Open the challenges board and pick a district
Clear its challenge icons one by one
Move district to district until 50 are complete

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you (the other protagonist in free roam or co-op), earn a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely without either of you being wasted or busted. The reliable method: cause a scene near a long tunnel or the metro lines, dive in when the fourth star lands, and stay out of sight until the stars clear. Do it before the finale, while the story still pairs you up by default.
steps: Ride together with your partner in one vehicle
Raise the wanted level to 4 stars
Break line of sight in a tunnel or metro line
Stay hidden until the wanted level fully clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in one unbroken wanted run with your partner: hold up a store, keep the wanted level alive while you drive to the next, and repeat. The chain breaks if the stars clear or either partner goes down, so pick three shops on one street grid, keep the car between them fast, and never hide long enough to drop the heat.
steps: Scout three shops close together on one street grid
Rob the first with your partner and keep the wanted level up
Drive straight to the second and third shops and rob both
The trophy pops on the third register

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles: a vehicle counts as discovered the first time you get in and drive it. Rich districts spawn the rare end of the list, so work the marina, the airport and the Ocean Drive valet rows, and steal parked novelties on sight rather than passing them by. The phone's vehicle log shows what you already have.
steps: Get in and drive every new vehicle model you spot
Work the marina, airport and valet rows for rare spawns
Check the vehicle log until 100 models are discovered

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aiming state. Set it up somewhere enemies bunch: a gang operation courtyard or a police standoff's first wave. Line up headshots before you trigger it, use a full-auto weapon, and sweep left to right without re-aiming from scratch.
steps: Find a spot where at least five enemies group up
Aim down the line of them before triggering Combat Focus
Trigger it and take all five down before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Status: unconfirmed. PlayStation's description says only to make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport), and no official source spells out the trigger. The community's best-supported reading is that it means leaving the airport in a plane you were never cleared to take: steal an aircraft from the VCIA apron and get airborne out of its airspace. This atlas marks the trophy unconfirmed until a method is verified; the steps below are the reported approach, not a promise.
steps: Enter the VCIA airfield side and find a fueled plane on the apron
Board it without filing any in-game flight plan or clearance
Take off and leave the airport's airspace
If it does not pop, retry with a different aircraft class

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Status: unconfirmed. The description is a joke with no plain instruction: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and the working community theory is that the trophy involves surviving inside a stolen Rhino at a high wanted level, or destroying one. Neither reading is verified by an official source. The reported approach is to steal a Rhino when the military responds at five stars and stay alive in it; this atlas will update the entry when a method is confirmed.
steps: Raise a five-star wanted level near a military response route
Steal a Rhino when one deploys
Survive inside it and keep fighting until the trophy pops
If it does not, try destroying a Rhino instead and note the result

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store with zero detection: no alarm, no witness call, no wanted level. Go at night with a suppressed weapon and a mask, enter from the back, control the room quietly, and take only the display cases before slipping out. If anyone raises the alarm the attempt is void, so leave and reset rather than improvising.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and approach at night, masked, suppressed weapon ready
Enter from the rear and control the staff without a shot
Empty the display cases and leave before any alarm
The trophy pops once you clear the area undetected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob the vaults of 5 different banks and escape the wanted level each time. Bank jobs are the heaviest free-roam robberies: case the bank, bring explosives or the drill the plan calls for, and stage a fast car two streets away rather than outside the door. Each clean getaway banks one of the five.
steps: Case a bank and stage a getaway car nearby
Breach the vault and take the cash
Escape and lose the wanted level completely
Repeat at four more distinct banks

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Trucks run fixed cash routes; the clean way is to block the route with a heavy vehicle, breach the rear doors with explosives, grab the cash bags and switch cars once to break the chase. A sticky-bomb ambush on a quiet stretch of route keeps the wanted level manageable.
steps: Follow an armored truck until its route turns quiet
Block it and blow the rear doors with explosives
Take the cash and swap vehicles to break the chase
Lose the wanted level to finish the robbery

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 named areas of Leonida so the map's fog clears over every district, island and wetland. An area counts when you physically enter it, not when you see it from across the water, so the Keys causeway and the swamp interiors need deliberate trips. Pair the sweep with the WAiNK spots and card sets to make every journey do double duty.
steps: Open the map and note which areas are still fogged
Travel through each one until its name registers
Take a boat for the island and Keys areas
The trophy pops when the 52nd area is entered

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation run by each of Leonida's 9 gangs: chop shops, labs, stash houses and fronts. An operation counts when you clear its guards and take the take, and the gang's colors and tags at the site tell you whose it was. Keep a list against the nine names in the game's gang dossier so you do not repeat the same gang twice.
steps: Find an illegal operation and identify its gang from the site
Clear the guards and take the cash or product
Log the gang and move to a different gang's turf
Repeat until all 9 gangs have been robbed

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Status: unconfirmed in its details. The description points at a specific leisure moment: ordering a cocktail at a beachfront spot on Ocean Beach with the ocean in view, most likely the rooftop or terrace bars along the strip. Which bar and whether time of day matters are not officially documented. The reported approach is to visit the Ocean Beach beachfront bars, order the cocktail from the menu interaction, and drink it facing the water; try sunset if a daytime attempt does not register.
steps: Go to the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach
Order a cocktail from the bar interaction
Drink it while facing the ocean view
If it does not pop, retry at another Ocean Beach bar at sunset

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass front. Take any car inside a dealership showroom (test-drive cars count), line it up with the window wall, and accelerate straight through the glass onto the street. The trophy registers the exit, not the theft, so the cheapest car in the room works fine.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom with display cars inside
Get in one of the showroom cars
Accelerate through the front glass onto the street

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a bowling game at the Kolt & Associates' alley and complete your follow-through: the trophy is tied to finishing a game at this specific alley rather than bowling anywhere. Start a full game at the alley, bowl every frame, and the trophy pops at the score screen.
steps: Travel to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Start a full game on a lane
Bowl all frames to the final score screen

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Status: unconfirmed. The description hints at the two protagonists doing something together that draws a crowd or an audience ('mass appeal'), and community theories cluster on a joint activity with spectators, such as winning an event together or performing for a crowd with your partner. No official source confirms the trigger. The reported approach is to complete partner activities at public venues with both protagonists present; this entry stays marked unconfirmed until a method is verified.
steps: Bring both protagonists together in free roam
Enter a public activity or event that draws spectators
Complete it together with your partner
Note what you were doing if it pops, as the trigger is unverified

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Status: partly unconfirmed. PlayStation tracks a count of 500 against this trophy, and the description frames it as choices made across the game: dialogue picks, spare-or-kill calls and approach selections are the tracked kind. What is unconfirmed is the exact list of actions that count. The safe play is simply thoroughness: make every choice the game offers rather than skipping interactions, and the counter fills as a by-product of a full playthrough plus the stranger content.
steps: Take dialogue and approach choices whenever the game offers them
Do not skip optional interactions with strangers and contacts
Check the trophy's tracked count in the PS5 card to watch progress
The trophy pops when the count reaches 500

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Status: unconfirmed. 'Second time's the charm' suggests failing something once and succeeding on the immediate retry: a race, a challenge or a timed errand are the usual suspects. No official source names the event. The reported approach is to deliberately fail a scored activity and then pass it on the very next attempt; if one activity type does not register it, work through the others (races, range challenges, drone courses) the same way.
steps: Enter a scored activity such as a race or range challenge
Fail it on purpose on the first attempt
Retry immediately and pass it on the second attempt
Repeat the pattern on another activity type if it does not pop

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Status: unconfirmed. The description is the game's wink at a strange-event encounter: Leonida's wetlands and night skies hold scripted oddities, and the working theory is that witnessing one specific unexplained event (lights over the swamp are the most reported) is the trigger. Nothing official confirms which event or where. The reported approach is to spend nights in the wetlands and investigate any anomaly you see rather than driving past it.
steps: Head into the Leonida wetlands after dark
Watch for unusual lights or events and move toward them
Stay and witness the event through to its end
Try other reported anomaly spots on later nights if needed

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle (a bike works best) and connect with someone on foot so they go down like a pin. You do not need a kill, just the knockdown, so a bat or pipe at moderate speed on a busy sidewalk does it in one pass.
steps: Equip a melee weapon and get on a motorcycle
Ride along a busy sidewalk at moderate speed
Swing as you pass a pedestrian and knock them down

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn a cumulative $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your fence contacts. Marked bills come from bank and truck robberies, so this trophy pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play: rob, pass the marked cash to a laundering contact rather than spending it raw, and repeat. The tracker counter here takes dollar amounts, so log each laundered batch.
steps: Rob banks and armored trucks to collect Marked Bills
Deliver the bills to a laundering contact
Log each laundered amount in this tracker
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops: weapons, ammo, clothing, vehicle parts, food and services all count toward the same total. It accumulates naturally across a platinum run; if you are short at the end, a full top-end weapon and ammo restock plus a luxury clothing pass closes the gap quickly.
steps: Spend normally on weapons, ammo and clothing as you play
Check the money-spent stat in the game's stats page
Top up with a high-end shopping pass if the total is short
The trophy pops when shop spending passes $100,000

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the Leonida property market. Garages unlock for purchase as the story opens districts, and their prices climb, so fund them from the heist and laundering income of stage 4 and 5. The property screen lists owned garages; the eighth purchase pops the trophy.
steps: Open the property listings on the phone as districts unlock
Buy each garage when its listing appears
Fund later garages from robbery and laundering income
The trophy pops on the eighth purchase

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, the in-game vehicle registry on your phone: park a vehicle you own (or have just acquired) and complete its registration in the app. Any 10 distinct vehicles count, and registrations pair well with Whip It Good, since the cars you discover can be registered as you go.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on the phone
Register a vehicle you are driving or own
Repeat with nine more distinct vehicles
